description: Compute the CRCs of the reveng catalogue (CRC-8/SMBUS and MAXIM, CRC-16 ARC/MODBUS/CCITT-FALSE/XMODEM/KERMIT/X-25, CRC-32, CRC-32C, BZIP2, MPEG-2, CRC-64 ECMA and XZ), Adler-32 and Fletcher-16 of some bytes; or, given the value a device or file expects, say WHICH algorithm produces it — also trying the bytes swapped, the usual reason nothing matches (Modbus sends the CRC low byte first). Custom Rocksoft parameters (width, poly, init, refin, refout, xorout) for anything else. Every algorithm is verified against its official check value. Language models cannot compute a CRC reliably by hand: use this instead.

algorithm.description: Only this one (id, name or alias: crc16-modbus, CRC-32C…). Default: all

custom.description: Rocksoft model parameters (hex), as in the reveng catalogue or a datasheet: {"width":16,"poly":"0x1021","init":"0xFFFF"}

expected.description: The checksum you have (hex): says which algorithm gives it, in either byte order

path.description: Path to a file: its raw bytes (up to 10 MB)

text.description: Data as text, encoded as UTF-8. One of text, hex or path

name: checksum
title: CRC, Adler-32 and Fletcher checksums — or which CRC gives this value
